name: battle-bugs
description: A modular 2D browser-based vehicle arena battler. Vanilla ES6 modules, HTML5 Canvas, procedural pixel-art.

scripts.check: node --input-type=module -e "for (const f of ['config/constants','config/partsData','core/EventEmitter','physics/Vector2D','physics/PhysicsEngine','entities/Part','entities/BattleBug','systems/EconomyManager','systems/CombatEngine']) await import('./src/' + f + '.js'); console.log('modules OK');"
